title: kbmon's kb panel cuts its refreshed, eval and index row at 80 columns, losing counts and dates
goal: at 80 columns the kb panel's rows keep every count, date and state whole, wrapping a ' · ' list at an item as kb/_self/monitoring.md's narrow rules say and cut only free text

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
def k(*a,env=None):
    t0=time.time();p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env or os.environ,timeout=120);p.wall=time.time()-t0
    if p.returncode not in (0,1): print('kbmon exit',p.returncode,p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(1)
    return p
p=k('--once','--panel','kb',env=dict(os.environ,COLUMNS='80'))
rows=[x for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if 'eval' in x or 'index' in x]
print(rows)
sys.exit(1 if not rows or any(x.endswith('\u2026') for x in rows) else 0)
